about: The records' own strokes, for `riffpunch.py --strokes`: riffpunch's per-stroke measures on six Meshuggah records' guitar stems at the clean onsets of our transcriptions, 30-90 s of each (`riffpunch.py --song ID --from 30 --to 90 --json`, the `ref` medians; `n` = the clean onsets read). Made by chirper-zero on 19 Nov 2026 (Extreme and Mean v23) on the groove pin 7138d6d5. To add a record: the same command on its reproduction, and its `ref` here.

lone_guitar.about: Where the record's guitar plays ALONE (cabspec's three passages: no separator in the way), the whole passage's 6-10 kHz less 1-4 kHz, read on the record itself and on its separated guitar stems over the same seconds (chirp-eco, 19 Nov 2026, ~/.local/state/chirp-eco/common-time/fizzread/fizzread.py). The stems lose 0 to 5 dB of fizz even there (bs_roformer_sw; htdemucs_6s up to 12.6), and under a full band they read -33 to -36: judge fizz against `record`, not against the stems' row.
